question: What will Salesforce report for GAAP diluted EPS for Q3 FY2027?

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 GAAP EPS guidance is $1.81-1.83 and assumes no change in the value of strategic investments. Recent quarters beat GAAP guidance by about $0.10 excluding investment gains (Q2: $1.86 ex-gains vs $1.75 guidance midpoint). Anthropic's priced rounds (Series G in Feb, Series H in May) drove the big Q1/Q2 gains. No priced Anthropic round turned up for Aug-Oct, and the IPO (priced Nov 18) falls after the Oct 31 quarter end, so a large Anthropic markup should land in Q4. The rest of the portfolio added roughly $0.2/share per quarter in H1, so a moderate positive gain is likely. Median ~2.03; the right tail allows for a small chance of an Anthropic mark tied to some Q3 transaction. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 GAAP EPS guidance is $1.81-1.83 (about 827M diluted shares; assumes no change in the strategic investment portfolio). After removing strategic-investment gains, Salesforce beat GAAP guidance by about $0.11-0.15 in Q1 and Q2 FY27. Most of the big recent swings (Q4 FY26 +0.66, Q1 FY27 +0.49, Q2 FY27 +2.43) came from markups of the Anthropic stake after its funding rounds. No Anthropic primary round seems to have happened between August and October 2026. The IPO priced on Nov 18, after the quarter closed on Oct 31. Salesforce values private stakes at cost and only re-marks them on observable transactions, so the IPO should land in Q4 rather than Q3. That leaves only modest gains or losses from the rest of the portfolio this quarter. The $3.6B Fin acquisition closed on Sept 10, ahead of its original Q4 target, so it is probably not in the guidance. Its amortization, deal costs, stock compensation and lost interest income should cost roughly $0.03-0.08. Median is about 1.93, with a small upside tail in case Salesforce books an Anthropic markup in Q3 anyway. No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market was found for this.
